Wishlist
----------
Add some form of grass sprites being kicked up when off road
Add shaking/bumping when in first person view.
Rain?
Improve fog effect - alpha rather than darkness?
Calculating sprite brightness each time - add distance brightness to colours table (list)
Colour table could easily be adjusted on the fly for shorter viewing distance in the dark (for example)
Improve skidding/drifting while turning
More racing tracks
Desert as well as grass?
Bridge over river?
Sound effects - for game
The weighted functions for creating random routes ignore the weight!
Hills should affect car speeds (both uphill and downhill) as should skidding (and/or drifting).

Bugs
-------
Slight corruption at bottom of screen every time a car overtakes
Collision is fairly hit-or-miss and generally abysmal - make it use z coordinates rather than segments and do box collisions. This will also be useful for AI.
MaxSpeed setting allows movement of more than one segment per frame - this is where collision issues really creep in!

Won't do
------------
Add online player vs player mode - because of cloud data limits of 100ms this isn't feasible to work well in a game of this nature
